Task 3 execution record (141.003-T).

Per-site containment review (mandatory before editing) for all 16 sites in
tests/test_backlog_root.py: CONTAINMENT NOT REQUIRED for any site. Every
test in this module calls autoharness.backlog_root.resolve_backlog_root(
workspace, env=...) directly -- a pure function testing the relationship
between a synthetic workspace and its own .backlog/.backlogit subdirectories
(override precedence, ambiguity, symlink/junction rejection). None of the
16 sites invoke the CLI, git, or any worktree/topology machinery (confirmed:
the only import is autoharness.backlog_root, no autoharness.cli or
autoharness.gates.topology). Unlike 141.002-T's victim #1 (which broke when
switched to system temp because the pipeline-topology CLI's own
worktree_topology check runs real `git worktree list` against the actual
repo), nothing in this file touches that surface. All 16 sites replaced with
plain tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() (N1).

EMPIRICAL VERIFICATION (per the task 2 lesson -- do not trust a static
read alone): ran tests.test_backlog_root in isolation before (original
dir=Path.cwd()) and after (this fix): Ran 16 tests ... OK in both cases,
identical pass count, no assertion weakened.

Removed test_backlog_root.py from the guard's ALLOWLIST in the same change
(now exactly {test_gates_topology.py}); guard is GREEN.

No victim (#1-#5) lives in this file, so the assertion-integrity gate (AIG)
does not formally apply here, but verified anyway: git diff shows only the
dir= keyword argument changed on each of the 16 call sites, zero assertion
lines touched.

AC-a: zero dir=Path.cwd() sites remain in tests/test_backlog_root.py.
AC-b: tests/test_test_suite_isolation_contract.py is GREEN with allowlist
== {test_gates_topology.py}.
AC-c: all 16 sites have a recorded containment determination with
justification (above -- uniformly "not required", verified empirically).
AC-d: satisfied (isolation parity above; no assertion weakened).
